data.narrative:
1872 is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $15M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader universe of 9 private peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ) within the robotics and manufacturing sector.

A Stage-Progression method was applied, using the $15M total raised as a proxy for entry valuation and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage progression. This method yielded an implied valuation of $38M. A Peer-Median approach was not applicable due to insufficient datapoints meeting narrow peer filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-valuation-tier screening yielded fewer than three comparables), and relying on all-sector peers would introduce material distortion given sector heterogeneity within robotics and manufacturing.

The triangulated valuation range is $32M to $43M, with a median of $38M. This range reflects a single methodological anchor and should be treated as preliminary. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x step-up multiplier for this specific company's capital efficiency and growth trajectory, and the absence of direct peer valuation data to cross-validate the stage-progression result. Additional traction metrics or comparable transaction data would strengthen conviction in this range.
